site_name: Flat B, 54-56 Cadogan Square, LONDON, SW1X 0JW
description: Internal alterations and refurbishment including - new mechanical, heating, electrical, lighting and hot and cold water installations;  internal reconfiguration - removal of partitions and walling; formation of two bathrooms and a kitchen and new partitions and doors, of a plant room over, of a new entrance door from common parts; opening up into roof space in principal spaces; upgrading of insulation and repairs to existing roofs; formation of a new velux rooflight; removal of one flat rooflight and the formation of two flat rooflights; renewal of trellises to existing roof terraces; replacement of existing oak flooring with new oak flooring on acoustic battens; redecorations.
